Hi Daniel,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and appreciate the clarity on FinPath's primary latency and cost targets for document parsing and chat assistants. As discussed, next best step is a 45–60 minute technical demo / deep dive where our Solutions Engineer can walk through a hands-on run and answer any integration questions.

Quick recap of the things you flagged: 
- Target P95 latency: <= 250ms for 2–3K token responses
- Production model needs to support VPC/private deploy for regulated PII workflows
- Procurement will want standard SLAs and a run-rate estimate 

Can we lock in one of these slots for a demo next week?
- Tue, Oct 20 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tue, Oct 20 — 14:00–15:00 PT
- Wed, Oct 21 — 09:00–10:00 PT

I’m looping in Rishi (sales lead) and Dev (solutions) so they have the right context. Also, if you could put your security contact in the thread (or let me know who to add), I’ll attach our security questionnaire and SOC2 summary so your team can start the review.

Those are meant to give you the high-level controls and an SLA template; if you need deeper artifacts (full SOC2 report or pen test results) we can route via our security pack and an NDA.

- 10 min: goals and current architecture review (FinPath)

- 15 min: security/routing/hosting Q&A and next steps
- 10 min: procurement and rollout milestones / MAP review

Attachments: FinPath_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (stub), SOC2-summary.pdf (stub), technical_deep_dive_agenda.pdf (stub), Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (stub)

Hi all — I’m Neha (Head of Security Partnerships at Redwood). Quick notes while we prepare pre-read: 
- Hosting: we support dedicated VPC deployments and an on-prem option; can walk through network diagrams at the deep dive.
- Data residency: we can pin regions (US/EU) and provide KMS integrations for keys.
- Compliance artifacts: attaching SOC2 summary; full SOC2 report available under NDA.

Question for FinPath: do you anticipate sending any raw customer PII to the inference endpoint, or will FinPath perform prior obfuscation/masking? That will affect our recommended rollout (dedicated vs. hosted private).

If you can share an answer before Tue, we’ll tailor the demo to showcase the right deployment pattern.

Thanks,
